elemancer_e01.description: Direct offhand spell damage increases 2/4/6/8/12%. Excludes staff basics, Q, burns and extra triggered effects. Maximum Mana increases by 4/8/12/16/20.
elemancer_e01.name: Focused Casting

elemancer_e02.description: Staff bolts deal 2/4/6/8/12% more damage. Hold your main attack to fire a bolt; quick melee taps do not count. Does not improve Q or damage from additional spell effects.
elemancer_e02.name: Arcane Fundamentals

elemancer_e04.description: A damaging offhand hit empowers your next staff basic within 6 seconds by 8/16/24%. One charge; refresh without stacking.
elemancer_e04.name: Spellweave

elemancer_e05.description: Hitting an enemy with a staff bolt extends your Burn or Soaked on that enemy by 1/2/3 seconds. Can happen once every 6 seconds. Burn can have at most 6 seconds remaining; Soaked can have at most 12. Adds no stacks and cannot restore an effect that has already ended.
elemancer_e05.name: Sustained Exposure

elemancer_e06.description: After taking direct damage, your next successful E cast within 3 seconds grants 10% direct-damage reduction for 2 seconds. 12-second trigger cooldown.
elemancer_e06.name: Elemental Shelter

elemancer_e07.description: Your own casting movement penalties are 10/20% smaller. No change to cast time or enemy control. Spirit-based mana regeneration increases by 10/20%.
elemancer_e07.name: Sure Casting

elemancer_e08.description: A staff basic empowers your next offhand hit within 6 seconds by 4/8/12%. One charge. Each empowerment still requires its own real attack.
elemancer_e08.name: Alternating Current

elemancer_e10.description: Damaging an enemy within 3 blocks with an offhand spell grants a shield equal to 3% of your maximum health for 3 seconds. Can happen once every 15 seconds.
elemancer_e10.name: Reactive Ward

fighter_f01.description: Basic weapon attacks deal 2/4/6/8/12% more direct damage. Includes fist punches. Excludes charged attacks, E, R, Q attacks, bleeds and echoes.
fighter_f01.name: Martial Training

fighter_f04.description: A damaging charged attack empowers your next basic attack by 6/12/18% for 4 seconds. One charge; a new charged hit refreshes rather than stacks it.
fighter_f04.name: Follow Through

fighter_f07.description: After blocking a hostile hit, your next basic attack within 3 seconds deals 25% more direct damage. One charge, 4-second trigger cooldown.
fighter_f07.name: Riposte

fury_y02.description: Increase charged battleaxe direct damage by 2/4/6/8/12%. Applies to either charged-attack replacement.
fury_y02.name: Axemanship

fury_y04.description: Basic attacks, axe throws and guard bashes that hit an enemy apply one of your Bleed stacks. Each stack deals 6% of your weapon damage every second for 4 seconds. Maximum: 3 stacks per enemy. Reapplying Bleed keeps the stronger damage and the longer remaining duration.
fury_y04.name: Ferocious

light_l01.description: Your direct healing increases 2/4/6/8/12%. Excludes shield grants and periodic healing.
light_l01.name: Merciful

paladin_p06.description: After directly healing an injured ally or absorbing hostile damage with a granted shield, your next basic hit within 4 seconds gains 20% direct damage. Eight-second trigger cooldown. No triggers from overhealing.
paladin_p06.name: Answer the Call

paladin_p23.description: While playing Hope with a sword and shield, generate 150% more threat from damage, effective healing, shields and tank ability bonuses: 10 times normal threat instead of 4. Always active once learned.
paladin_p23.name: Righteous Fury

perfection_p02.description: Basic fist attacks deal 2/4/6/8/12% more direct damage. Does not affect kicks, guard attacks or Q.
perfection_p02.name: Practiced Hands

perfection_p05.description: Completing a three-punch string restores 1 additional Chi, at most once every 3 seconds. The baseline string still restores its normal 1 Chi.
perfection_p05.name: Gentle River

rogue_r01.description: Uncharged sword and dagger hits deal 2/4/6/8/12% more direct damage. Excludes kunai, Q and secondary damage.
rogue_r01.name: Light Blades

rogue_r02.description: Maximum Stamina increases by 3/6/9/12/18%. No change to regeneration delay.
rogue_r02.name: Deep Reserves

rogue_r05.description: Reduce Stamina spent by dodge, Shadow Dodge and double jump by 4/8/12%. Excludes grapple and ability costs.
rogue_r05.name: Second Step

rogue_r06.description: Negating a hostile hit with a timed dodge empowers your next basic attack within 3 seconds by 20%. Once per 6 seconds. Passive dodge-chance rolls do not qualify.
rogue_r06.name: Turn the Tables

rogue_r07.description: A damaging basic hit after at least 2 seconds without a melee hit grants 5/10% movement speed for 2 seconds. Once per 6 seconds.
rogue_r07.name: Stay Close

rogue_r08.description: Basic and charged attacks from behind an enemy ignore 5/10/15% of their armor. You must be within the 120-degree area directly behind them.
rogue_r08.name: Find the Gap

rogue_r09.description: Your first dodge after falling below 35% HP removes ordinary slows. 25-second cooldown. Does not cleanse roots or damage over time.
rogue_r09.name: Clean Escape

rogue_r10.description: Your first basic hit after 3 seconds without dealing direct damage gains 5/10/15% damage. A failed or blocked attempt does not spend the bonus. 8-second trigger cooldown.
rogue_r10.name: Patient Approach

steam_t01.description: All of your Sol spells and your Burn deal 2/4/6/8/12% more damage. This applies to your full fire kit, not only Cinderstep.
steam_t01.name: Firecraft

steam_t03.description: Personal burns last 0.5/1/1.5 seconds longer at unchanged damage per second. Remaining duration caps at 6 seconds including gear.
steam_t03.name: Patient Fire

steam_t05.description: Your offhand Bolt becomes Fire Bolt: it deals 85% of normal Sol Bolt damage and applies your Burn. Same 2-second cooldown; no push.
steam_t05.name: Fire Bolt

steam_t06.description: Your offhand Bolt becomes Solar Bolt: it deals 90% of normal Sol Bolt damage to its target and 35% to up to two other enemies within 2 blocks. Same 2-second cooldown.
steam_t06.name: Solar Bolt

steam_t07.description: Heal for 4/8/12% of your Burn damage, capped at 1% maximum health per second after modifiers across all victims.
steam_t07.name: Burning Passion

steam_t08.description: Reduce Cinderstep's base cooldown by 0.5/1 second, from 6 seconds to 5.5/5 seconds. Distance, fire trail duration and collision limits are unchanged; it grants no invulnerability.
steam_t08.name: Cinderstride

steam_t09.description: Learn Flame Jet in offhand slot 2. Hold right-click to channel a seven-block flamethrower sweep where you look. Costs 10 mana per second with no cooldown, ending when you release or run out of mana. Every 0.4 seconds, deal 25% of normal Sol Bolt damage to up to 3 enemies and refresh your Burn. You can move while casting; basic attacks cost no mana. Choose this or Backdraft. E and R remain available.
steam_t09.name: Flame Jet

void_touched_h_strength.description: Rot Brand applies 1/2/3 additional stacks of your Rot, for 4/5/6 total. The normal ten-stack maximum still applies.
void_touched_h_strength.name: Deep Brand

void_touched_v01.description: Your basic dagger attacks deal 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8/1.2% more damage for each of your Rot stacks already on the enemy, up to 2/4/6/8/12% at ten stacks. Rot applied by that hit does not count toward its bonus.
void_touched_v01.name: Rot Attunement

void_touched_v02.description: Charged dagger hits deal 2/4/6/8/12% more direct damage. Applies to charged replacements, not Q.
void_touched_v02.name: Dagger Discipline

void_touched_v03.description: Rot duration increases from 6 seconds to 7/8/9 seconds. Never changes tick cadence; all extensions including equipment cap at 12 seconds.
void_touched_v03.name: Lingering Infection

void_touched_v04.description: Heal for 5/10/15% of your Rot damage and the Rot-bonus portion of a consuming hit. Shared ceiling 2% maximum health per second after healing modifiers.
void_touched_v04.name: Void Siphon

void_touched_v06.description: Shadow Dodge cooldown becomes 2.75/2.5 seconds from 3; travel increases by 5/10%. No extra invulnerability.
void_touched_v06.name: Hollow Stride

void_touched_v07.description: Negating a hostile hit during Shadow Dodge's 0.2-second protection grants 1 second concealment and 5% maximum Stamina. Six-second trigger cooldown; attacking or direct damage breaks concealment.
void_touched_v07.name: Umbral Reflex

void_touched_v10.description: Double Jump vertical strength increases 10/20%. At rank 2, the first valid wall jump in an air chain refreshes the air-dodge permission once; it does not clear Shadow Dodge's timer.
void_touched_v10.name: Rift Acrobat

void_touched_v21.description: Your first uncharged dagger hit made while concealed gains 10/20/30% direct damage, then reveals you under the normal concealment rules. Eight-second trigger cooldown across all concealment sources. No Q, charged, Rot or echo benefit.
void_touched_v21.name: Quiet Predator

void_touched_v22.description: Breaking Void Cloak's concealment with a dagger hit applies 3 of your Rot stacks to that enemy. Has no effect if Void Cloak is replaced.
void_touched_v22.name: Ambush
